body.statement: Using the handle \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{exact}}\), determine whether \(\kappa_-=\kappa_+\), compute the common constant if it exists, and characterize all asymptotically extremal dual-tight obstruction geometries up to dummy-row padding, replication, and vanishing perturbations. If the limit fails to exist, determine the exact set of subsequential limits of \(N\Delta_N\).
body.justification: The order theorem leaves a nontrivial geometric extremal problem rather than presenting the loose universal constant as sharp.
body.gap: Neither empirical Monge counterexamples nor mixability approximation theory identifies the exact normalized same-marginal squared-cost loss or its extremizers.
body.consumer: An exact constant would replace the conservative universal width by a sharp planning and reporting benchmark at moderate trial sizes.

obligation.what_is_open: Whether \(\kappa_-=\kappa_+\), the value of a common limit if it exists, and the classification of all asymptotically extremal dual-tight geometries remain open.
obligation.obstruction: The handle \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{exact}}\) supplies neither a proved finite obstruction catalogue nor a compactness theorem preserving normalized slack under block decomposition.  Even after the arm-specific refinement, the cluster-count, residual, and quadratic-charge inequalities are not jointly certified sharp, while the padded four-row witness need not maximize them.
obligation.attempted: The ordered slope intervals were compressed into arm-specific nested dyadic blocks, residual tables were sparsified and repaired exactly, and the four-row zero-slack face was solved over the reals and integers.  The sharper accounting closes the uniform rate with constant 402 but still provides no matching constant-level variational principle or exclusion of larger irreducible blocks.
obligation.partial_result:
The proved frontier gives the sharper compact localization
\[
 \frac1{46080}\le \kappa_-\le\kappa_+\le402.
\]
The lower endpoint is witnessed for every \(N\ge4\) by one fixed four-row obstruction padded with isolated dummy rows, while the arm-specific ordered-support multiscale repair supplies the upper endpoint.  Thus the \(N^{-1}\) order and the absence of an arithmetic exceptional subsequence are settled.  What remains unresolved is equality of the two asymptotic constants, the value of a common constant if it exists, and the classification of all extremal obstruction geometries.
